units.source_text: 雨点变小了，山岭明亮起来。

en.t: The raindrops grew smaller, and the mountain ridges began to brighten.

units.source_text: 老太婆一再挽留我说：“再待十分钟，天空放晴，定会分外绚丽。”

en.t: The old woman urged me again and again to stay, saying, "Wait just ten more minutes, and when the sky clears, it will surely be especially beautiful."

units.source_text: 可是，说什么我也坐不住了。

en.t: But no matter what anyone said, I could no longer sit still.
